Subject: Request: add 5 new product teams + credentialing timeline

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We finished our internal review and want to expand Redwood usage to five additional product teams across Data, Insights, and Customer Integrations. High-level asks:

- Separate API keys (one per team) with namespaces for telemetry and rate-limits
- Start with a staged rollout (2 teams in Dec, 3 in Jan) to manage quota and QA
- Updated pricing for incremental capacity (we expect ~120M tokens/mo additional across teams)
- A brief amendment to our current agreement to reflect term and capacity changes

Can you share a proposed rollout plan, estimated cost delta, and a draft amendment we can review with procurement? Procurement is cc'd here — they want to see timelines to match budget cycles.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Alex Gomez
Head of Product Integrations | HealthLytics

2) Cost delta & capacity sizing: Ben will attach a short estimate for the incremental token usage and pricing bands for Dedicated vs Hosted routing.

Attachments: HealthLytics_project_matrix.xlsx (fill in team names & target go-lives), redwood-amendment-draft-v1.pdf

Best,

Hi Alex / Priya —

Putting in the numbers Ben promised. TL;DR: incremental 120M tokens/mo maps to the following (hosted pricing example):

- Baseline tier (covered by current commit): 0–50M tokens incremental -> $0.0035 / 1k tokens
- Mid tier: 50–150M additional -> $0.0028 / 1k tokens
- If you want dedicated routing for consistent latency and isolation we recommend a Reserved Pool step-up (adds $Xk/mo for the pool + lower per-token)

For the staged rollout I recommend:
- Phase 1 (Dec 6): enable Team A + Team B, reserve an initial 40M tokens for burst safety
- Phase 2 (Jan 10): enable Teams C, D, E with incremental capacity bump to hit the 120M target

I've uploaded a short capacity snapshot image (capacity_snapshot_Q4.png) and the pricing workbook into the shared folder (Drive link below / HubSpot HS-54821).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHL-HealthLytics-Docs
HubSpot: HS-54821
